# SeedThree generator subset

Unmodified `src/core/{weber-penn,branch-mesh,rng}.js` from
https://github.com/SkyeShark/SeedThree at commit
`cf2eaad39d9b7355ed086aca2a95fb785e539242`.

MIT, copyright (c) 2026 SkyeShark; full notice in LICENSE. No upstream

parameters, foliage geometry, bark art and placement live in forest.ts.
